key_insight: RobustRLlib brings robust reinforcement learning algorithms into a unified library and benchmark, making them easier to reuse and compare. It targets a clearer picture of how well these methods handle changing or disrupted environments.
problem_solved: Robust RL methods are difficult to reuse across implementations, and their strengths and limitations under different disruptions remain unclear.
method: Build an algorithm-centric library integrating 17 representative robust RL algorithms.
Provide a unified benchmark to compare robustness capabilities.
Address implementation reuse and empirical evaluation within one framework.
impact: A shared library and benchmark could help practitioners select and evaluate robust RL methods for more reliable deployment. The provided abstract is incomplete, so specific performance gains and benchmark findings are not available.
visual_elements: Hub-and-spoke diagram showing 17 algorithms connected to RobustRLlib.
Before-and-after graphic contrasting fragmented implementations with a unified library.
Policy–environment loop with icons representing shifts and disruptions.
Conceptual algorithm-by-disruption comparison matrix, without invented scores.
paper_title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
paper_authors: Xi Chen, Fengqi Hu, Zeyu Shen, Jiaying Xu, Shangding Gu
